functions.name: generate_website
functions.title: Generate Website Blueprint
functions.description: Skip-traces a business website, benchmarks the top 5 sites in its industry, and produces an original website content blueprint with hero, services, and design tokens. Call when the user wants to create a new website project from a business URL and industry.

businessWebsiteUrl.description: The source business website URL to research and extract content from.

industry.description: The target industry, e.g. Roofing, HVAC, Dental.

businessName.description: Optional business name to use in the generated content.

functions.name: generate_brand_assets
functions.title: Generate Brand Assets
functions.description: Generates a logo and a hero image from text prompts using AI image generation. Call when the user wants to create or refine brand visuals for a website project.

logoPrompt.description: Detailed prompt describing the logo style, colors, and mood.

heroImagePrompt.description: Detailed prompt describing the hero scene, subject, and lighting.

functions.name: generate_vision
functions.title: Generate Vision Statement
functions.description: Produces an AI-refined vision statement and alternatives from a seed description and optional accent color. Call when the user is starting a new build project and needs a vision to anchor the strategy.

seed.description: A short description or idea to anchor the vision generation.

accentColor.description: Optional hex color for the vision, e.g. #00d4ff.

functions.name: generate_strategies
functions.title: Generate Strategies
functions.description: Generates strategy options from an approved vision and selected capability add-ons. Call after a vision is approved and the user wants to explore strategic directions for the build.

vision.description: The approved vision object, containing statement, type, tagline, and alternatives.

addons.description: Optional list of selected capability add-on names to factor into the strategy.

functions.name: research_industry_templates
functions.title: Research Industry Templates
functions.description: Analyzes the top 5 rated sites in an industry for style, layout, SEO, AEO, and GEO, then stores the findings as design-guidance templates. Call when the user wants to refresh or build out the template library for an industry.

industry.description: The industry to research, e.g. Roofing, HVAC, Dental.

functions.name: mass_launch_sites
functions.title: Mass Launch Location Websites
functions.description: Skip-traces a business once, benchmarks the industry, then generates a strategically location-tailored website for every market listed. Call when the user wants to launch a multi-location campaign with original content per market.

businessWebsiteUrl.description: The source business website URL to research.

industry.description: The target industry for all variants.

locations.description: List of target locations or cities, one per variant.

tone.description: Optional preferred brand tone, e.g. Professional, Friendly, Premium.

goal.description: Optional primary conversion goal, e.g. More qualified leads, Online bookings.

functions.name: instantiate_site_template
functions.title: Instantiate Site Template
functions.description: Takes a saved site template and a set of variable values, then produces a business-specific website project with generated content and brand assets. Call when the user wants to spin up a new site from an existing template.

templateId.description: The id of the SiteTemplate to instantiate from.

variables.description: Key-value pairs filling the template's placeholder variables, e.g. business_name, location, phone.

functions.name: universalize_project_template
functions.title: Universalize Project Into Template
functions.description: Converts a generated website project into a reusable, universal industry template by replacing business-specific details with placeholder variables. Call when the user wants to turn a finished site into a reusable template for future projects.

projectId.description: The id of the WebsiteProject to universalize. The project must have generated content.

functions.name: deploy_site_vercel
functions.title: Deploy Site To Vercel
functions.description: Renders a website project's content into a static HTML site and deploys it to Vercel, returning the live URL. Call when the user wants to publish a generated website project to a live URL.

projectId.description: The id of the WebsiteProject to deploy. The project must have generated content.
